payload.statement: LightGBM forecasts price levels it cannot extrapolate, dragging the ensemble median below the last close on every run.
payload.mechanism: A tree model on levels regresses toward its training window mean; in a rally that is a persistent negative bias.
payload.prediction: On future cutoffs the lightgbm median sits below the last close in >80% of runs and the ensemble loses to the random walk on pinball.

payload.statement: The numerical suite is not deterministic at a fixed cutoff; LightGBM medians vary across same-cutoff runs.
payload.mechanism: Multithreaded LightGBM training is not bit-deterministic and the RNG seed includes weights.
payload.prediction: lightgbm_p50_spread across the ten lite runs at one cutoff exceeds 0.05 on most cutoffs.

payload.statement: A dead component model silently renormalises the ensemble weights instead of failing the run.
payload.mechanism: CfmEnsemblePredictor tolerates failures and renormalises over survivors.
payload.prediction: Records with failed_models non-empty exist and their forecasts differ materially from siblings.

payload.statement: Interval width is regime-blind; the width the outcome required rises steeply with volatility while the published width is roughly constant.
payload.mechanism: The ensemble's spread is a Monte-Carlo width with no regime input; the multipliers only fire on LLM request.
payload.prediction: omega_needed exceeds 1.5 in the high-volatility tercile far more often than in the low tercile.

payload.statement: The policy cannot widen an interval without also justifying a centre move, so most widening requests are refused.
payload.mechanism: Uncertainty actions are downgraded with the tier that gates the centre.
payload.prediction: More than half of proposed widenings are granted 'unchanged'.

payload.statement: v5.2 zeroes about half of its own proposed moves on citation bookkeeping, not on market judgment.
payload.mechanism: A claim must link an accepted summary and a resolved source associated with it; the LLM wires citations inconsistently across draws.
payload.prediction: The zeroed rate stays above 40% and varies across same-cutoff draws.

payload.statement: incremental_novelty is an ungated 2x multiplier that flips across draws at one cutoff.
payload.mechanism: partly_reflected halves the overlay outside the policy's view.
payload.prediction: Cutoffs where the ten lite runs split on novelty are the majority.

payload.statement: Equal 1/3 ensemble weights were never measured; fitted weights beat them out of sample.
payload.mechanism: Components differ in bias and calibration; a pinball-optimal pool moves weight off the biased member.
payload.prediction: Weights fitted on history through 2021 beat equal weights on 2022+ origins and on live rows.

payload.statement: The ensemble has no random-walk member and so cannot express 'today's price is the best centre'.
payload.mechanism: All three components regress the level; a random-walk member anchors the pool.
payload.prediction: A random-walk anchor fitted on history reduces live pinball toward the random walk's.

payload.statement: There is no explicit directional output, so direction is unscoreable on half the horizons.
payload.mechanism: A neutral centre action is 'no call', not a call of flat.
payload.prediction: More than 40% of horizons publish no directional call.

payload.statement: Decision-LLM draw-to-draw variance is the size of the signal.
payload.mechanism: Temperature and seed are unpinned; the published overlay depends on which draw ran.
payload.prediction: Published p50 spread across the ten lite runs exceeds the mean absolute overlay.

payload.statement: Four verifiers check provenance and form; none checks whether the conclusion follows from the claims.
payload.mechanism: An adversarial 'does the action follow' verifier is missing.
payload.prediction: Triage tags JUDGMENT.* with pointers on at least a third of acted horizons.

payload.statement: Intervals are never verified; empirical coverage is far below the nominal 80%.
payload.mechanism: MC-sampled widths with 0.7-1.3 multipliers and no calibration.
payload.prediction: Coverage stays below 50% until a width scale is applied.

payload.statement: Reasoning errors cannot be located because only final rationales are stored.
payload.mechanism: The recorder keeps the structured assessment, not the agent turn.

lever.note: capture decision transcripts (out of scope for the coach; proposal only)

payload.prediction: Deep dives return 'undetermined' on reasoning questions more often than not.

payload.reason: Base table data refutes the prediction; direction calls are made in almost all cases across horizons and streams.

payload.statement: A substantial share of verified summaries are accepted with empty text, which prevents the LLM from making informed decisions.
payload.mechanism: Scraper or parser errors return empty text, which the verification pipeline accepts without warning or retrying, leading to extremely thin context packets.
payload.prediction: At least 15% of active forward runs contain at least one empty accepted summary.
